headlines.title: Can PepsiCo's Snack Pricing Strategy Drive Volume Growth?
headlines.summary: PEP's snack pricing and affordability actions are fueling volume gains and stronger consumer demand, while rising costs and margin pressures remain challenging.

headlines.title: Casey’s Country Comes Together to Support America’s Military Community
headlines.summary: ANKENY, Iowa, November 04, 2026--Casey's stands with our nation’s veterans, service members and military families who have sacrificed in service to our country through its annual round-up campaign benefiting Hope For The Warriors (HOPE).

headlines.title: PepsiCo Remains a Popular Choice for Dividend Investors
headlines.summary: We just covered the 10 Most Undervalued Dividend Growth Stocks According to Hedge Funds and PepsiCo (PEP) ranks 10th on this list. Insider Monkey tracks more than 1000 hedge funds and 68 of these funds had a bullish long position in PEP stock.

headlines.title: What Is PepsiCo (PEP) Gaining From Its Expanded Beverage Partnership?
headlines.summary: PepsiCo (NasdaqGS:PEP) renewed and expanded its long term beverage partnership with Taco Bell for U.S. and international markets. The refreshed agreement keeps PepsiCo as Taco Bell’s exclusive beverage partner while widening distribution of products like Mountain Dew Baja Blast. The collaboration includes plans for new functional and energy drink offerings positioned across both established and emerging beverage categories.

headlines.title: CULINARY INSTITUTE OF AMERICA ANNOUNCES ANNE FINK AS BOARD CHAIR, WELCOMES TWO NEW TRUSTEES
headlines.summary: The Culinary Institute of America (CIA) has elected its 24th board chair: global food and beverage executive, Anne Fink. Fink is currently President of Global Foodservice at Fortune 50 food and beverage company PepsiCo.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
